- The repository root is C:\Code\Projects\APP-StackMap
- The working tree is clean

Add this one line under the appropriate unreleased or maintenance section of CHANGELOG.md:

- Verified Entire checkpoint capture from a Codex CLI session.

Do not modify any other file.

Review the complete diff and confirm only CHANGELOG.md changed.

Commit with this exact message:

Test Entire checkpoint capture from Codex CLI

Push the current branch to origin.

Do not merge anything.
Do not manually modify Entire checkpoint refs.

After pushing, report:

1. Commit ID
2. Any Entire hook output
3. Checkpoint ID, if shown
4. Whether the commit contains an Entire checkpoint trailer

6. Whether the checkpoint ref was pushed
7. Final git status
I’ll verify the repository, branch, clean state, and Entire linkage first. I won’t edit or commit unless all prerequisites match exactly.
